backup.title: Backup aur Restore

backup.setupProtectionHint: Browser cache saaf karne se setup dobara nahi aayega. Sirf Super Admin factory reset se setup wizard khulega.
backup.guideIntro: Yeh page aap ke saare bills, customers, users aur settings ko mehfooz karti hai — PC par ya cloud mein.
backup.exportFormatsDesc: Sirf teen formats — JSON, CSV, ZIP
backup.guideStep1: Rozana: Jaiza tab → JSON / CSV / ZIP dabao ya Cloud Par Backup.
backup.guideStep2: Auto backup: Schedule tab → Daily/Weekly/Monthly choose karo → Save Schedule.
backup.guideStep3: Naya Firebase: Migrate tab → export → naye project par import → confirm → archive.
backup.guideStep4: Wapas lao: Tareekh tab se cloud restore, ya Jaiza se JSON file upload karo.
backup.guideStep5: Load kam karo: Maintenance/Migrate se purana data soft-archive (delete nahi hota).

backup.factoryResetDesc: Setup lock hata deta hai. Dubara setup wizard aayega. FACTORY RESET likho.

migrate.importStep2: Is POS ko naye .env keys ke sath deploy karo.
migrate.importStep3: JSON Setup wizard ya Firebase Console se import karo.
migrate.importStep4: Login karke bills, customers, users naye project par check karo.

migrate.quickArchiveDesc: Pehle backup, phir purane orders/logs soft-archive — main load kam ho jayegi.
migrate.footerNote: Bills hard delete nahi hoti. Archive data Firestore mein rehta hai — kabhi bhi wapas la sakte ho.
